tonight.headline: Maye-day fixed their lineup — this is now a coin flip, and Tuten sat out Wednesday
body: Bad news first: Bloodsports are 2-7 and the morning's 58% is gone — ESPN now has it 126.3 to 129.0, 49%, after Maye-day benched their bye-week players. Bhayshul Tuten did not practise Wednesday (ankle/foot) and is questionable; Jacobs is out; Loveland is on bye; Wilson and Pickens are both questionable on the bench.

Two things before Thursday 19:15: add Zvada for Gay (free agent, 2.4) and, by Sunday 12:00, Gordon for Marks at FLEX (1.8, the projection's coin flip). Then one check at 10:30 Sunday: if Tuten is out, Marks takes his RB slot.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Maye-day (9-0) moved Luther Burden III and the Bears D/ST (Chicago bye) out and the Packers D/ST in at 16:15Z; their lineup now has no zeros. Jaxon Smith-Njigba projects 22.4, Drake Maye 20.8.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten inactive with neither Gordon nor Marks moved correctly, or Gay left in at K — each costs about two points in a game ESPN calls even.

doFirst.title: Add Dominic Zvada, drop Matt Gay
doFirst.subtitle: Free agent — no priority spent. Still not made at 22:05Z; it has to happen before Zvada's Thursday kickoff.

case.label: The gap
case.body: Zvada 10.7, Gay 8.3: 2.4 points, the biggest kicker gap on either roster. Zvada is still a FREEAGENT in IPADE at 22:05Z, so the add costs nothing that lasts.

case.label: The kicker
case.body: Giants rookie; missed three field goals in the Week 5 overtime tie with Washington (FantasyNerds 11 Oct) — the same opponent Thursday. That miss rate is the honest risk.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Gay, 54% rostered — disagreeing with the market on the record: K17 this week, and Las Vegas just traded their quarterback Kirk Cousins to Minnesota (Yahoo, 10 Nov). Gay offers nothing Zvada does not.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Gay outscores Zvada in Week 10 (archive).

doFirst.title: Start Gordon at FLEX, bench Marks
doFirst.subtitle: The projection's FLEX by 1.8 — a coin flip, so it goes to the projection and carries no thesis.

case.label: The call
case.body: Gordon 15.8, Marks 14.0 (lineup_check.py: COIN FLIP). Marks went in for Jacobs at 05:28 CDMX; the projection prefers Gordon.

case.label: What research adds
case.body: Gordon gets Kyle McCord's first start (UPI/Yahoo 11 Nov) and had 94% of Miami's carries in Week 9. Marks' risk is Montgomery, still TBD (DK 10 Nov). Neither is unpriced news. If Tuten is inactive Sunday, Marks comes back in at RB — this swap does not cost that cover.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Marks outscores Gordon in Week 10 (archive). No decision-log entry: coin flip.

whatWentWrong.title: The Zvada add from this morning is still not made
whatWentWrong.lead: Free, 2.4 points, and it closes when Zvada's Giants kick off Thursday 19:15 CDMX.

case.label: What it is
case.body: Gay is still at K at 22:05Z and Zvada is still a free agent. The morning card stands unchanged; only its clock has shortened.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A rival adds Zvada first (free-agent adds are invisible to this brief), or a Giants kicker injury before Thursday.

whatWentWrong.title: IPADE priority was spent on a streaming defence
whatWentWrong.lead: Rams D/ST claimed at 02:46 CDMX for the Jaguars D/ST. Priority never resets in IPADE.

case.label: Why it matters
case.body: STRATEGY §4 reserves IPADE priority for an immediate starter or league-winner. The Rams do face Carson Beck's first start (ESPN 11 Nov), and their bye is Week 11.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing to undo; graded on Week 10 against the Jaguars D/ST (archive).
